verdict.rationale: The pack never documents group rules, dynamic group membership, or assigning apps to groups. SCIM's user/group schema is a provisioning building block, and the MCP example of adding a user to a group is a one-off manual grant. Neither shows rule-driven or group-based app access, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, access is assigned by group and rule — dynamic group membership and group-based app assignment replace one-by-one grants
